# SOrderedList `<s-ordered-list>`

A numbered list. `SOrderedList` is the typed Vue 3 wrapper for Shopify's Polaris `<s-ordered-list>` web component.

```ts
import { SOrderedList } from 'polaris-vue-elements'
```

## Best practices

- **Use it when the sequence means something.** Numbered lists convey order, priority or ranking, so they fit step-by-step instructions or ranked recommendations. If the order is irrelevant, use `SUnorderedList` instead.
- **Write items the same way.** Give every item matching grammar and structure so the list reads easily. Switching styles from item to item makes readers work harder.
- **Keep each item short.** Lists work because they're quick to scan. If items grow long or involved, consider breaking them out into their own sections.
- **Don't nest too deeply.** One level of nesting can organize related points, but going past two levels gets hard to follow and suggests the content needs a different structure.

```vue
<SOrderedList>
  <SListItem>Choose a shipping carrier</SListItem>
  <SListItem>Print the shipping label</SListItem>
  <SListItem>Mark the order as fulfilled</SListItem>
</SOrderedList>
```

See [Shopify's best practices for `<s-ordered-list>`](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/app-home/latest/web-components/layout-and-structure/ordered-list#best-practices) for the full guidance.

```vue
<script setup>
import { SUnorderedList, SOrderedList, SListItem, SStack } from 'polaris-vue-elements'
</script>

<template>
  <SStack direction="inline" gap="large-500" alignItems="start">
    <SUnorderedList>
      <SListItem>Free shipping over $50</SListItem>
      <SListItem>30-day returns</SListItem>
      <SListItem>24/7 customer support</SListItem>
    </SUnorderedList>
    <!-- SOrderedList renders its SListItem children as a numbered list. -->
    <SOrderedList>
      <SListItem>Add items to your cart</SListItem>
      <SListItem>Review your order</SListItem>
      <SListItem>Confirm and check out</SListItem>
    </SOrderedList>
  </SStack>
</template>
```

## Props

| Prop | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `children` | `any` | The content of the OrderededList. Accepts only `ListItem` components. |
| `id` | `string \| undefined` | A unique identifier for the element. |

## Slots

| Slot | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `default` | The list entries displayed within the ordered list, where each item is numbered sequentially. Only accepts list item components as children. Each list item represents a single numbered entry in the sequence. |
